request.deadline: 9-month delivery period from July 2026 to March 2027
deliverables: Audited Bitcoin-Cardano bridge running on Cardano mainnet under controlled access
Support for both federated and SPO-threshold custody modes
SPO and dApp partner pipeline required for public launch
request.what: Phase 1 of 2 funding to take Bifrost from working testnet to launch readiness, including hardening, security audits, formal verification, ecosystem and partner readiness, stewardship, and economic foundations for launch.

claims.claim: Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano's SPO ecosystem that brings BTC onto Cardano as a native Cardano asset.
The bridge is already live on testnet under Catalyst Fund 14, with working peg-ins and peg-outs and participating SPOs.
The proposal requests ₳12,332,031, approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA, including a 10% refundable contingency, for a 9-month Phase 1 delivery period.
By the end of Phase 1, Bifrost will be an audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in federated and SPO-threshold modes under controlled access.
Public rollout and 24 months of operations are excluded from this request and are intended for a Phase 2 proposal in Q1 2027.

Bifrost custody of locked BTC is proposed to be distributed across 400+ Cardano SPOs weighted by delegation, with movement of funds requiring a cryptographic threshold representing the majority of delegated stake.
Bifrost smart contracts, off-chain tooling, and SDK are released under Apache 2.0 so anyone can audit, fork, run, or build on the bridge without permission.
The proposal says Bifrost has no bridge token, no founder allocation, and no built-in revenue claim for the founding teams beyond delivery compensation from this proposal.
Bifrost targets 1,200 BTC, about 600,000 annual transactions, and 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets by Q2 2029 after the full two-phase rollout.
Bridge fees in fBTC are expected to fund operations, with surplus split to SPOs and the Cardano Treasury.

summary: The document describes a large treasury request for Phase 1 launch-readiness work on Bifrost, a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge intended to move from testnet toward audited controlled mainnet operation, but several key technical, economic, and adoption claims are asserted rather than evidenced in the supplied text.
